fact: The Banque Centrale de Djibouti sought consultants (expressions of interest due 30 October 2024) for the AFD-financed PAREFID project, whose first component is to set up the national digital payment system, or national switch, to ensure interoperability between banking and financial actors.
title: Manifestations d'Intérêt - SERVICES DE CONSULTANT, Projet d'appui à la réforme du secteur bancaire et financier de Djibouti (PAREFID)
